# Dashboard Visual Component Quantum Measurements

## 1. Scope

Docs-only runtime visual audit for dashboard component geometry. This file is the only intended persistent artifact for this task.

| Included | Excluded |
| --- | --- |
| Runtime DOMRect measurement for all requested dashboard surfaces across 10 viewports | UI implementation, UI fixes, product code, CSS, tests, backend, API, auth, DB, Supabase, dependencies, lockfiles, CI |
| Read-only use of docs/audit/dashboard-visual-component-taxonomy.md | Screenshots persisted to repo |
| Playwright real Chromium browser against local dev server and e2e fixture API | Git stage, commit, push, PR, cleanup of preexisting untracked files |

## 3. Measurement Method

For every route and viewport, Chromium loaded the local Next dev server with e2e populated session cookies. After the route ready selector attached, the script waited for network idle when available and an additional 1250 ms for responsive/adaptive layout to settle.

Each candidate component was selected by priority: data-testid, data-dashboard-*, data-admin-*, data-clinic-*, data-module, data-surface, then dashboard/admin/clinic class fallback only when no stable data attribute existed on that element.

DOMRect values are from getBoundingClientRect at runtime. area_px2 = width * height. viewport_area_px2 = viewport_width * viewport_height. area_viewport_percent = area_px2 / viewport_area_px2 * 100. visible_area_px2 is the intersection of the DOMRect with the viewport and overflow-clipping ancestors. visible_area_percent = visible_area_px2 / area_px2 * 100. clipped is true when visible_area_px2 is lower than area_px2.

External scroll uses max(documentElement.scrollHeight, body.scrollHeight) - documentElement.clientHeight. Internal scroll uses element.scrollHeight - element.clientHeight for each measured candidate. Pass in the no-scroll table requires external_scroll_delta = 0.

## 12. Measurement Risks

| Risk | Impact on these measurements |
| --- | --- |
| Dynamic data | Fixture row counts and statuses define rendered lists; production data can change density and scroll. |
| Session fixtures | Only e2e populated clinic/admin sessions were used; missing real permissions can hide role-specific states. |
| Lazy rendering | Closed tabs, drawers, popovers, menus and dialogs are not mounted or can appear as 0x0/hidden. |
| Hidden modules | Only the requested route state was measured; inactive tab panels and paged-away rows are documented as hidden or absent. |
| Drawers/menus visible only after interaction | No click-open interaction was performed, so those overlays are not measured unless mounted by default. |
| Animations | A fixed wait was used after network idle; slow animations can still affect subpixel DOMRect values. |
| Responsive hydration | Next dev + adaptive pagination can remeasure after first paint; the 1250 ms settle wait reduces but does not eliminate this risk. |
| Device scale factor | All requested viewports used explicit deviceScaleFactor=1; CSS pixel geometry is comparable across the matrix. |
